name: Responsive Slideshow
description: Bundled content type plus a block that renders recent slideshow nodes as a Bootstrap 5 carousel.
project_description: Responsive Slideshow renders a Bootstrap 5 carousel from site content. Installing it creates a locked 'Responsive Slideshow' content type with fields for a slide image, a teaser/body, a link, and a 'hide detail page' flag, plus an image style 'responsive_slideshow_style' (image scale-and-crop to 1320x347). The module provides one block, 'Responsive Slideshow' (plugin id responsive_slideshow, category Blocks). When rendered, the block queries the most-recently-changed published responsive_slideshow nodes (limited by a configurable slide count), builds each slide's image URL through the image style, escapes alt/title, truncates the title to 90 characters and the description to a configurable length, resolves each slide's link, and renders the theme hook slideshow_data (templates/slideshow-data.html.twig) as standard Bootstrap 5 carousel markup. The module ships only a CSS library (css/responsive_slideshow.css); it carries no slider JavaScript and depends on the site's Bootstrap 5 theme to supply Bootstrap's own carousel behavior. A settings form at /admin/config/user-interface/responsive_slideshow (permission 'administer responsive slideshow') controls the number of slides, maximum description length, and auto-advance interval in milliseconds. The block output is uncached (max-age 0).
